checklists.ecoregion_name: Central California Foothills and Coastal Mountains
Santa Barbara Coastal Plain and Terraces

species_unit: resolved_species_name from upstream full v3, not subspecies-level resolved_taxon_name
preserve_positive_rule: Positive supporting GBIF point in supplied boundary or Ecdysis named-species record with locality explicitly naming Dangermond. Genus/higher IDs do not create species flags; ABSENT records do not establish presence. A positive flag is preserve-wide, not evidence of occurrence in that checklist ecoregion or a particular dune habitat. Coordinate uncertainty not buffered.
blank_rule: Blank preserve flag means not documented, not absent. Level III life-history notes remain blank.
bold_policy: User explicitly restored all records with resolved species determinations, including BOLD/iBOL/BIOUG/CBG sources. All v3 regional records retained. Named preserve BOLD records can support a positive flag after boundary/name checks; genus-only and unresolved BIN records do not establish species. This supersedes the earlier blanket BOLD exclusion for these checklists.
classification_rule: Prefer service ORDER/FAMILY; missing service values fall back to original GBIF. Choose weighted modal pair over regional source records, with ties sorted lexically. Conflicts logged separately.
life_history_notes: Removed with source from Level IV at user request; Level III retains its blank legacy field.
notes: Regional candidate lists, not lists of confirmed preserve species. Candidate occurrence counts use source records, not individualCount; no new date/deduplication filter. Local surveys mark presence without increasing regional GBIF record counts. Preserve evidence may contain overlapping sources; its rows must not be summed as independent biological events.
